reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
ABH IL will only reimburse for the appropriate reporting of urodynamic testing when 
• 
Urodynamic testing is reported with an ICD-10-CM diagnosis code that is indicated as 
appropriate by this policy 
 
Claims that are submitted will be denied when 
• 
Urodynamic testing is reported with an ICD-10-CM diagnosis code that is not indicated as 
appropriate by this policy 
 
The medical record documentation is expected to support the specific CPT code(s) and ICD-10-
CM codes reported.

This policy outlines the coding and editing guidelines for reporting of urodynamic testing. Urinary 
incontinence is the inability to voluntarily control voiding of urine from the bladder. Urodynamic 
testing is conducted to evaluate how well the bladder and related body structures store and 
release urine.

voiding pressure studies (ie, bladder voiding pressure), any technique
